result_text:
I fixed the path patterns for the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I did not add tests for the new matches. The existing scoping tests (`*Scoping*`) pass.

- **HTML generators (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the path pattern was `(html|html|xhtml)`, with `html` listed twice. It is now `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages are recognized and `.html` and `.xhtml` still match.
- **`.NET` doc XML and `// Generated by` JS:** the patterns `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js` only matched a file literally named `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`.
- **Gradle JS:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` lands in the build-and-deployment scope. `.*[.]gradle` is unchanged, so `build.gradle` still matches.

I left the content patterns alone. Hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of the generated scope because the content pattern still has to match within the line limit.
